description: Safe, constrained MCP tools for regulatory evidence access. These tools provide structured access to regulatory data WITHOUT exposing raw FDA/NHTSA/FAA APIs to LLMs.

tools.name: reg.getEvidenceForRun
tools.description: Get complete regulatory evidence package for a simulation run. Returns structured evidence from FDA/NHTSA/FAA databases.

returns.description: Complete RegulatoryEvidence object with queries, findings, and summary

tools.name: reg.summarizeEvidence
tools.description: Get a concise natural-language summary of regulatory evidence for a run. Useful for quick status checks and report generation.

returns.description: Natural language summary of evidence (2-3 sentences)

tools.name: reg.compareEvidence
tools.description: Compare regulatory evidence across multiple simulation runs. Identifies common findings and differences.

run_ids.description: List of run IDs to compare (2-5 runs)

returns.description: EvidenceComparison object with differences and commonalities

tools.name: reg.getCriticalFindings
tools.description: Get ONLY critical severity findings for a run. Use this to quickly check for blocking regulatory issues.

returns.description: Array of critical findings (empty if none)

tools.name: reg.getMetrics
tools.description: Get health metrics for regulatory data sources (FDA/NHTSA/FAA). Shows request counts, success rates, and latencies.

returns.description: Metrics summary from all regulatory clients

forbidden_tools.name: reg.callFdaRaw
forbidden_tools.reason: Direct FDA API access is NOT exposed to LLMs. Use reg.getEvidenceForRun instead.

forbidden_tools.name: reg.callNhtsaEndpoint
forbidden_tools.reason: Direct NHTSA API access is NOT exposed to LLMs. Use reg.getEvidenceForRun instead.

forbidden_tools.name: reg.queryArbitraryEndpoint
forbidden_tools.reason: Arbitrary endpoint queries are NOT allowed. All queries go through the evidence service.

usage_notes: All tools return structured, sanitized data - never raw API responses
Tools have built-in rate limiting and caching to respect provider ToS
For medical domain, evidence includes FDA device recalls and adverse events
For AV domain, evidence includes NHTSA vehicle recalls and complaints
For UAV domain, evidence includes FAA airworthiness directives and UAS regulations
Tools automatically handle timeouts, retries, and errors
Results are cached for 1 hour to minimize redundant API calls

examples.description: Get evidence for an HBCM cardiac simulation
Check for critical issues in an AV simulation
Compare evidence across two HBCM runs
